preservedResponsibilities: Direct TypeScript port of the pinned md4c 0.5.3 UTF-8 block, mark-resolution and callback pipeline. Preserves source byte offsets, callback chunk boundaries and attributes, source flag defaults, reference budgets, container state and callback abort codes. All 813 complete callback streams match compiled unmodified md_parse, including 733 bundled CommonMark/extension cases. Native allocation failures, C pointer ABI and unused/uninitialized fields are not emulated. Writer callback integration remains pending; these dependency fixtures do not establish complete Writer import parity.

B8TCAE adds14 minimized public UTF8 input/flag cases to the existing native-edge callback corpus: unclosed/escaped link destinations and labels, terminal angle prefixes, table delimiter/header boundaries, collapsed spaces, unmatched strikethrough/math delimiters and terminal WWW slashes. All complete initialized callback streams are regenerated by the unchanged pinned md4c0.5.3 source after exact archive/member verification. Existing full callback and block-consumer suites replay the same cases. Diagnostic selection only read per-call Istanbul deltas; temporary diagnostics were removed and no source state, coverage counter, exclusion or threshold was changed. Current6 suites1848 tests pass; exact-map before/after comparison closes11 statements and19 branch arms. Remaining full100 coverage and ABI/resource-failure claims are not certified.

The user separately approved M01 for the CDATA return shadowed by the preceding ASCII test (WRITER144), and M02 for the absent-end alternative although actual md_line_contains always returns end on hit/miss. Stable counted UTF8 buffers and original static helper output are the explicit preconditions. A pinned original-C caller captures4/0/0/7 declaration outcomes, trailing table whitespace and initialized hit/miss end offsets. Exact runtime-token/remapped-counter proof excludes only one zero-hit statement and two zero-hit alternatives;1912 assertions cover174 statements,212 arms,14 functions and142 lines at100. No parser normalization/fix, threshold change or full native Writer certification is added.
